title: Moonshot AI publishes Kimi K3.1 Pro open weights
summary: Moonshot AI has published open weights for Kimi K3.1 Pro on Hugging Face, the first model in its K3.1 series. The model is natively multimodal and agent-oriented, with 2.8 trillion total parameters, 104 billion active parameters, and roughly 1 million tokens of context; the weights are released in MXFP4 quantization. Moonshot also offers an API through platform.kimi.ai under the kimi-k3.1-pro identifier, compatible with OpenAI and Anthropic interfaces. The supplied material does not include verified benchmark results.

references.title: The largest open model ever runs on 3.7 percent of itself
